scoring_justification: For eta, result-level comparison with monotonic/directional thresholds is used because recomputing finite-size scaling is infeasible. For pattern densities, structural recompute from CSV is feasible (pattern set membership and ratio). The ground-state regimes are verified structurally.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference η values for D/|J|=0 and -1 at low temperature, derived from paper Fig.2 and text.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig.2: η≈0.317 for D=0, η=0 for D=-1 at low T (T ≤ 0.35). Error bars around ±0.01.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper text and figure; tolerance set to 0.05 for D=0, upper bound 0.05 for D=-1.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Directly traceable to the paper's reported critical exponent; the reference oracle writes values that satisfy these gold criteria.

hidden_assets.purpose: Structural rules for pattern densities and ratio from paper Fig.3 and text.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: D/|J|=1 only patterns summing to ±1 without zeros; D/|J|=-1 one of two equivalent sets {p6,-p8,-p12} or its flip; D/|J|=0 mixture with ratio ~2.7:1 (p3/p6 ratio).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper description of local pattern densities.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's explicit structural claims for each phase.

outputs.description: Correlation exponent η as a function of temperature for D/|J| = 0 and -1, extracted via finite-size scaling of MC data.
Densities of local triangular spin patterns at low temperature for D/|J| = 1, 0, and -1.
Text file listing ground-state phases and their D/|J| ranges.

output_contract.notes: The Monte Carlo simulation step writes evidence mc_data.npz, which is not directly scored but required to produce the scored artifacts. All scored artifacts are derived from this simulation data.

steps.description: Validate η values for D/|J| = 0 and -1 across temperature against paper reference behavior.
Verify local triangular pattern densities satisfy structural requirements for D=1,0,-1.
Audit ground-state regime text contains correct phases and D/|J| intervals.
